text:
Ava: Quick check — where do we land on the Dashboard Observability roadmap? Specifically: retention policy for traces/metrics, ownership for tracing hooks, and the error-analysis view rollout.
Ravi: For retention, I updated the proposal in the doc last night — default still 30d, opt-in 90d for enterprise. PR to apply config is here: https://git.redwood/infra/retention-config/pull/88
Marta: I can own trace hook wiring (eng-ml -> console). I need a signal on required attributes (span_id, sample_rate, user_id opt-in). Anything else I should include?
Ken: @Marta pls include `request_id` and `service_version`. Also need a migration plan for existing traces (backfill + TTL).
Li: From product: error-analysis view should surface grouped stack traces, top N exception messages, and a time-window compare. Default retention for the view follows trace retention. Product wants canary on staging for first rollout.
Ava: @Ravi are there infra blockers? I remember a storage schema change that was supposed to land this week.
Ravi: Blocker: the chunked-shard migration is scheduled Wed 03/25 (deploy-bot scheduled it). Until that is in, we can't change the TTL config safely. deploy-bot: migration scheduled — window Wed 03/25 01:00-03:00 UTC, rolling across regions.
Marta: OK, I'll hold the trace-hook PR until migration clears. I'll open the PR draft with unit tests and example payloads today: `git push origin trace-hooks-marta`
Ken: I can review the PR on Thursday; heads-up I'm out Tue-Wed afternoon.
Ava: Ownership: Marta for trace hooks, Ravi for infra config + migration, Ken for canary + runbook, Li for product acceptance. I'll own coordination and rollout timeline.
Li: Timeline check — product requests canary in staging by next Monday so we can validate UX flows before customer beta mid-April. Is that feasible?
Ravi: If migration stays Wed, we can flip TTL on Thu and run a 48h canary window. That makes Monday for staging too tight but possible if Marta's PR and Ken's review land by Thu EOD.
Marta: I'll prioritize the PR comments. ETA for draft by EOD today, final by Thu morning.
Ken: I'll block 2 hours Thu morning for review and can start the staging canary runbook after approval.
Ava: Action items summarized: 1) Marta — PR draft + payload examples (today). 2) Ravi — monitor migration, prepare rollback knobs (Wed). 3) Ken — review PR (Thu AM) and runbook. 4) Li — prepare acceptance checklist for error view. Ping me if any slip. :thumbsup:
Ravi: One dependency note: the retention config change touches the same API that Dedicated uses for quota accounting. I'll coordinate with eng-dedicated to avoid regressions.
Li: I'll notify the Dedicated PM to expect a brief window.
Ava: Thanks all. If anything changes I’ll post an update here.
Ken: small nit — add a metric in the canary: `obs.trace.ingest.latency_p95` so we can detect perf regressions.
Marta: noted, adding that metric to the canary dashboard.
Ava: closing loop — next status update here after migration finishes or if any of the owners raise a block.
